_comment: Written by the Security Review persona. The pre-tag CI job reads this to decide whether a release is covered by a current audit. Do not hand-edit. not_verified (tsanetgit/Zendesk_App#140): claims a review could not check. An entry is never removed; a later review carries it forward or sets its status to resolved or not_applicable with a resolution, and scripts/audit-record-fields.py fails the record if a prior id is missing. NV-001 to NV-008 were migrated once from the notes prose of the v1.0.50 record and this record, all left open for the next review to decide.
open_findings: [HIGH][issue lane, existing issue tsanetgit/Zendesk_App#101] v1 webhook management endpoints are removed after 2027-01-01 (spec: POST /v1/webhooks deprecated, x-sunset 2027-01-01, 'This endpoint will be removed after 2027-01-01'; develop and beta). QUICK_START.md:418-435 instructs members to register with /v1/webhooks and explicitly not v2, and scripts/rotate-inbound-webhook.py rotates through v1, so the documented onboarding and inbound-credential rotation paths stop working on that date for certain. Whether TSANet keeps DELIVERING to existing v1 subscriptions after the sunset is not stated in the spec and was not verified; if delivery stops too, inbound ticket creation stops for every unmigrated install (#101's own statement). #101 is labeled enhancement/zis/high-priority but not security, is on no project board, and was last updated 2026-07-31; the release gate's findings query (open issues labeled security) cannot see it. Observable evidence the mechanical signal produced no action: the 97e41f3 record carried this as a 136-day WARN and #101 has had no activity since. Not filed as a new issue: recommended disposition is to label #101 security (+high-priority) and schedule it; acceptance is artifacts, not the label (dual-path bundle accepting v1 pings and v2 CloudEvents during transition, v2 rotation script, an install inventory that does not depend on GET /v1/webhooks, migration released to members before 2027-01-01). Awaiting Shawn's go.
notes: DELTA record: extends 97e41f3 across PRs #228, #229, #231, #232, #233 and #237 (git log 97e41f3..32cbc4b). Watched-path drift: zis/tsanet_connect_bundle.json, zaf-build/assets/tsanet_connect_bundle.json, zaf-build/manifest.json (version line only, 1.0.70->1.0.71), scripts/security-audit.py. No .github/workflows change in the window.
SELF-REVIEWED: the reviewing session also authored #237 (as the Coder persona). independent_pass is false. An independent pass from a separate session would clear this flag.

#237 (ZIS update path applies the sidebar's Partner and Respond By rules): no findings. Cat3 blast radius unchanged (a forged ping still only triggers a re-fetch of the case by token from TSANet) and writes are narrower (CheckForChanges routes no-change to NoOp; safe_update and updated_stamp kept). Cat4: Partner on INBOUND is now submitCompanyName, the same data class the create path already writes; the tsanet_updated retention selector is still applied. Cat6/live probe on d3v-tsanet (Beta-paired), 2026-10-09, bundle built from the live bundle with only flow_handle_ping changed: partner fix, partner fix plus Respond By clear, outbound no-op, re-ping no-op, tag-only write, and a status transition plus Respond By set, each confirmed from ticket audits. The compared field set equals the written set by construction (one three-element list feeds both). Cat7: no new rendering sink.

AUDIT TOOLING (#229, #231, #232, #233): differential run on the 32cbc4b tree, the 97e41f3 script versus the 32cbc4b script, gives identical outcomes (21 PASS / 1 WARN / 1 FAIL, same two non-PASS items; only a check name changed). No loosening on this tree. Crediting logic was not exercised beyond this tree.

MECHANICAL: 21 PASS / 1 WARN / 1 FAIL at 32cbc4b. FAIL = 'no unexcused calls to sunsetting endpoints', nearest sunset 84 days (threshold 90d, security-audit.py SUNSET_FAIL_WITHIN_DAYS): background.html:96 (audit-degrades marker, #153) and scripts/rotate-inbound-webhook.py (owned by #101). This is the check working as designed; it crossed from WARN to FAIL on 2026-10-03. release.yml maps any nonzero audit to flag_coverage, so every release until the v1 calls are removed publishes 'NOT covered by a current security audit'; approving such a release accepts the risk and is recorded on the run. WARN = the degrades-marked background.html:96 call.

PRE-REGISTERED: the acceptable way to clear the sunset FAIL is removing the v1 calls through #101 and #153. Raising SUNSET_FAIL_WITHIN_DAYS, adding a blanket allow marker, or marking #101 accepted to quiet the gate is not; any of those is a loosening the review would flag.

NOT VERIFIED: TSANet's v1 delivery behavior after 2027-01-01; member instances' own triggers keyed on ticket updates (they now fire only on real changes); PROD-paired ZIS behavior (only d3v/Beta probed); marker-crediting behavior beyond this tree.
